task: Add remove_work_item_relation and move_work_item tools to the ADO Work Item toolkit to enable reparenting work items without hitting TF201036.

key_reasoning.reason: Two new tool classes (RemoveWorkItemRelationTool, MoveWorkItemTool), two input models, two ToolMetadata constants, and toolkit registration. All within the existing ADO Work Item toolkit boundary — no cross-component changes.
Six files changed: models.py, tools_vars.py, tools.py, toolkit.py (source), test_tools.py, test_toolkit.py (tests). 365 lines added total.

The atomic patch pattern (remove + add in one update_work_item call) is consistent with the existing link_work_items implementation. The endswith URL check prevents the subtle substring false-positive. ADO errors propagate as ToolException strings, matching the existing error handling convention.
